basic_profile.bio: Hailing from Reno, Nevada, I'm a 27-year-old software developer passionate about hockey and fantasy sports. I spend my evenings diving into fantasy leagues and keeping up with the latest episodes of The Flash. As a lifelong fan of the sport, I enjoy discussing strategies and player stats. In my downtime, I also help peers prepare for the TOEFL test, sharing tips and advice from my own experiences as a non-native English speaker. Currently single, I enjoy the flexibility to dive deep into my hobbies, especially during late nights. I usually log in to Reddit after work hours, around 7 PM PST, while winding down.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and a love for hockey, I've combined my analytical skills with my passion for sports to become an adept fantasy league player. I also have a strong foundation in English language teaching, having tutored peers for the TOEFL exam.
